name: Blood Drive
description: Join Beta Theta Pi for our quarterly Blood Drive with Oneblood - right on the library patio. Appointments can be made the week before, or by walk-in appointment. Save a life with Beta - and make an impact beyond yourself.

name: Beta Theta Pi Formal
description: Beta Theta Pi's Annual Formal Dance will be held at the always popular Ink N Ivy in Downtown Greenville on March 22nd from 7 pm to 10 pm.

name: Beta Theta Pi Chapter Meeting
description: The Zeta Lambda Chapter of Beta Theta Pi will host a weekly meeting to conduct the duties and responsibilities of the chapter. Each member of the executive board will present a brief report of the progress in their area, then there is an open forum.
